description: FREE. Find Health Canada-licensed medical devices by trade name — licence number (`licence_no`), first licensed, licence end date (`licence_end_date`), and `active` (derived from the end date: no end date, or an end date today or later, means active). Top 5, sorted active first, then by match quality (`exact`, `prefix`, `partial`), then latest end date. Optional `active_only` (boolean, default false) returns only active licences. Counts: `found`, `active`, and `shown`. Each row includes `match_type`. Name searches can match the wrong device; when matches are not exact or come from several licences or companies, a top-level `warning` advises confirming with licence_detail using `licence_no`. Results include `retrieved_at` (ISO 8601 UTC) and `source_updated_at` (when the upstream Health Canada data was fetched, including cache hits).

active_only.description: If true, only active licences are returned. Default false.

name: device_search
